import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import native, image
from nativetest import rand_tree
rng=random.Random(17)
for trial in range(40):
    R=rng.randint(1,12)
    starts=sorted(rng.sample(range(0,1<<40),R))
    hops=[rng.choice([None,0,1,7,99]) for _ in range(R)]
    layout=rand_tree(rng,R)
    for node in layout:
        spread=starts[node['lo']+node['span']-1]-starts[node['lo']]
        node['mode']=rng.choice([0,1,2])
        if node['mode']==1 and spread>=(1<<64): node['mode']=0
        if node['mode']==2 and spread>=(1<<32): node['mode']=0
        node['cached']=rng.randint(0,1)
    addresses=[rng.getrandbits(128) for _ in range(rng.randint(0,10))]
    objs=[{'lo':n['lo'],'span':n['span'],'mode':n['mode'],'cached':n['cached'],'children':[]} for n in layout]
    for i,n in enumerate(layout):
        for ch in n['children']: objs[i]['children'].append(objs[ch])
    cimg,cans=native.pack(starts,hops,objs[0],addresses)
    pimg,pans=image.pack(starts,hops,layout,addresses)
    assert cimg==pimg, ('image mismatch',trial)
    assert cans==pans, ('answers mismatch',trial,cans,pans)
print('python packer matches the native packer byte for byte')
EOF
